Class MuiSyncedSession

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.api.Session
com.sbancuz.offscreen.integration.mui2.MuiSyncedSession
public final class MuiSyncedSession extends Session
Binds one offscreen Window to one server-synchronized ModularUI screen. The divert mixin captures the answering screen; it is attached on the next client tick. Lookups run through the SessionRegistry. The session does not automatically reopen a screen closed by the server.

Each request has a monotonically assigned token. A factory match alone is insufficient: an old cancelled reply must not populate a newer window from the same factory. ARRIVING describes the current framework construction callback; pendingArrival transfers a complete screen to tick-time attachment. Lifecycle decisions and requests remain on the client thread.

    • onArriving

      public static void onArriving(com.cleanroommc.modularui.api.UIFactory<?> factory, int networkId, net.minecraft.network.PacketBuffer data)
      Marks the start of the framework's arriving client screen construction. Peeks at the hosted token without advancing the buffer reader index, leaving normal factory deserialization to read the same bytes afterward.
      Parameters:
      factory - responding framework factory
      networkId - newly assigned network binding ID
      data - encoded GUI data at its current read position

    • clearArrival

      public static void clearArrival()
      Ends an arrival construction scope and releases any cancelled/unclaimed hosted reply. If a different container already owns the player, only deactivate this stale binding locally; a stale close packet could otherwise close the replacement.

    • tryDivert

      public static boolean tryDivert(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiScreen screen)
      Diverts a hosted framework screen away from the main Minecraft window. A matching pending session receives the reply. An unmatched nonzero token is still diverted, but retained for cancellation cleanup by clearArrival.
      Parameters:
      screen - GUI wrapper the framework was about to display normally
      Returns:
      true when this is a hosted response and normal display must be skipped

    • isOpening

      public boolean isOpening()
      Reports whether this session is waiting for a server response. Toggle actions use this to keep repeated key presses from closing the pending window.
      Returns:
      true while a live session still awaits a server response

    • poll

      protected void poll()
      Accepts safely queued network/background results on the client thread. Session's default implementation does nothing. Subclasses own the thread-safe handoff mechanism. Consumes a parked response once and attaches it on the client tick.

      Allows recovery while the player still owns this session's container, no intentional close was recorded, and no ModularUI screen is open in Minecraft's main window.

    • heal

      protected void heal()
      Re-establishes the framework binding in the same window. If this sends an asynchronous request, call Session.beginAwait() to bound the wait. Sends a new factory request with a fresh token and waiting budget.
      Specified by:
      heal in class Session

    • onRelease

      protected void onRelease()
      Releases framework references and performs any required server close handshake. Runs after untracking and before the final native window close attempt. Releases both attached and parked bindings, then clears retained framework references. The base session closes the native window afterward.
      Specified by:
      onRelease in class Session
